essence: The unconquered figure appears directly with skill under the leadership of Indra and Agni
Yaśodā's joyful delighter is identified as a rising presence over the earth
The attainer of Brahma's world serves as protector for caṇḍālas and all other beings
Lakṣmaṇa, Rāma's companion and son of Sumitrā, is the slayer of Indrajit
Bharata is characterized by slaying vast numbers of gandharvas and destroying Lavaṇa
